Yellow.idle: Grazes and shoulders through brush at a slow, deliberate lumber, head down, in no hurry because nothing in the biome usually bothers it back.
Yellow.when_locked: Breaks into a heavy, clumsy gallop the instant the red ring snaps on -- no finesse, just bulk thrown in the opposite direction, veering in wide stumbling zig-zags that are slow to start and slow to correct.

Red.idle: Never fully still -- flicks between grazing spots in short, twitchy hops, head snapping up at the smallest motion.
Red.when_locked: Explodes away in a blur of frantic, tight zig-zags, changing direction almost faster than the eye can follow, using every bit of its speed just to panic in a smaller radius.

Blue.idle: Keeps to open sightlines and high vantage rather than thick cover, drifting along the edges of clearings, watching more than grazing.
Blue.when_locked: Flees in long, raking zig-zags that favour open ground over cover, putting distance ahead of concealment, as if it trusts its eyes more than its legs.

Purple.idle: Lurks at the edge of rocks and foliage, ducking in and out of cover in short bursts rather than grazing in the open.
Purple.when_locked: Weaves erratically between whatever cover is nearest, cutting sharp zig-zags from rock to bush to rock, evasive out of habit rather than commitment.

Grey.idle: Moves with an unhurried, almost bored confidence, grazing in the open without bothering to watch its back.
Grey.when_locked: Breaks that calm instantly -- a surprising, powerful burst carries it away in loose zig-zags, betraying speed the lumbering idle pose never suggested.

grazers.idle: Stands and grazes in place, calm and limbless, oblivious until something gets close -- no colour, no watchfulness, nothing to lose.
grazers.when_locked: Freezes for a single beat the instant the ring locks on, then bolts in a panicked, erratic zig-zag away from the player -- never turning to fight, never slowing, just putting ground between itself and whatever just noticed it.

Yellow.territory: Holds a fixed patch of ground and does not wander from it, planting itself between the player and whatever it is guarding.
Yellow.wind_up: Plants all four limbs and visibly swells before lunging -- a slow, ground-shaking crouch that keeps closing distance the whole time it winds up, so standing still to admire it is a mistake.

Red.territory: Prowls a tight loop around its pocket rather than holding one spot, always somewhere close by when the player crosses in.
Red.wind_up: Drops into a coiled crouch and then closes the gap in one explosive blur -- the crouch is the only warning, and it is brief.

Blue.territory: Holds high or open ground at the edge of its pocket, keeping the player in sight from as far away as possible.
Blue.wind_up: Rears back and lines up a long lunge from well outside easy striking range, often staying at distance through the wind-up instead of closing, so the danger is reach, not proximity.

Purple.territory: Never sits still in one place -- slips between nearby cover at the fringes of its pocket, hard to pin down before it attacks.
Purple.wind_up: A short, feinting crouch that shifts angle at the last instant, still closing the whole time but never on the line the player expects.

Grey.territory: Patrols a broad stretch of ground with total confidence, in no rush because nothing in its pocket challenges it.
Grey.wind_up: A slow, full-body coil that telegraphs from a distance -- unmistakable, unhurried, and closing the entire time, backed by enough force that outlasting it is not an option.

Fins.arena: A deep marsh hollow -- still water, reeds, a pocket that looks calm right up until it isn't.
Fins.opening: The water's surface breaks as it comes up to meet the challenge, and the pocket's other occupants start converging on the noise before the fight is even a few seconds old.
Fins.wind_up: Rears half out of the water and holds, gill slits flaring wide on its face, before driving forward -- it never breaks off, never flees, and keeps coming regardless of how the fight is going.

Claws.arena: A rocky outcrop on high ground, exposed and cramped, with little room to circle wide.
Claws.opening: It drops down from the rocks above to meet the player head-on, and nearby ridge-dwellers start closing in from the surrounding stone almost immediately.
Claws.wind_up: Digs its hooked ridges into the rock and hauls itself into a braced crouch before launching -- a heavy, obvious tell that it never uses to run, only to close.

Coat.arena: The foothills below the lethal cold line -- open, wind-scoured ground just short of the peaks.
Coat.opening: It breaks from a loose gathering of grazers it was hunting and turns square on the player instead, while whatever else is nearby starts drifting in to join.
Coat.wind_up: Hunches low under its matted shell, gathering itself for a long, driving charge -- slow to start, impossible to miss, and never once aimed at the exits.

Heat.arena: Volcanic vents along the shore, heat-shimmer over cracked ground where the sand gives way to rock.
Heat.opening: It rises out of the vent haze as the player nears, the scorched seam across its face glowing brighter, and the pocket's other residents start turning to converge.
Heat.wind_up: The glowing seam flares hot before it commits to the lunge -- a bright, unmissable tell from a creature that has nowhere else it would rather be than in this fight.

Yellow.emergence: The lair's ground stops merely trembling and the den itself opens; it comes out slow, heavy, and utterly unhurried, because it knows it does not need to rush.
Yellow.hunt: Closes distance like a landslide -- steady, flat-paced, never sprinting because it never has to, grinding down any gap the player tries to open.
Yellow.tell: Plants itself, swells, and holds a beat longer than any ordinary Yellow before its lunge -- bigger, slower to commit, and much harder to shrug off when it lands.

Red.emergence: Bursts from the stirring den already moving, a streak of colour where a moment ago there was only bones and scorched ground.
Red.hunt: Strings together aggressive bursts rather than one long chase -- closing, breaking off, closing again -- so it is never quite where the player last tracked it.
Red.tell: A tight, explosive crouch, shorter and harder to read than an ordinary Red's, then it is already closing.

Blue.emergence: Rises into view from far across the stirring lair, already watching before the player has spotted it.
Blue.hunt: Keeps its distance and forces the player to close the gap, lunging in long punishing arcs whenever they do.
Blue.tell: A long, visible rear-back that starts well outside normal striking range -- easy to see coming, hard to actually escape once it commits.

Purple.emergence: Slips out of the den almost without ceremony, there one moment, gone the next, already circling.
Purple.hunt: Never commits to a straight chase -- ducks in for a hit, peels away, reappears from a different angle a moment later.
Purple.tell: A brief, flickering crouch that is easy to miss once and impossible to unsee after the first time it costs the player Health.

Grey.emergence: The den collapses open and it simply walks out, unbothered, because there was never any doubt it would win the wait.
Grey.hunt: Presses every angle at once -- closes ground, punishes retreats, and gives no single obvious weak point to exploit.
Grey.tell: A commanding, full-body coil, slower to read than the others but backed by enough force on the pounce that mistiming the dodge is expensive.
